    return f"{prefix}AWSLogs/{org_id}/{account_id}/CloudTrail/{region}/{date.year}/{date.month:02d}/{date.day:02d}/"

def download_cloudtrail_logs(target_dir, bucket, cloudtrail_prefix, org_ids,
